name: IP ICR-MRP Filler Integration
brief: Assembly Order / Purchase Order subcontracting orchestration for integrated fillers (ICR).
description: Implements the Functional Design Document for ICR-MRP integration v3: Create PO Link, outbound production request and BOM transmission, inbound completion processing, partial completion, over-receipt, pricing validation, scrap posting, phantom lot (ADO 1507) assignment and the Filler Integration Activity Log.
